To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Bi2O2Te single crystals were grown, their transport properties were studied in the temperature range from 80 K to 470 K, and the reduced Fermi energy was determined.
the single crystals of Bi2OSe were grown by gas-phase transport reaction and the transport properties were measured.
we have grown Bi2O2Te and Bi2O2 Se single crystals by gas-phase transport reaction.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis and characterization of Bi2OSe single crystals, which are of interest as a promising material for thermoelectric energy conversion.
the synthesis and investigation of the electronic properties of the bismuth oxyselenide Bi2O2 Se.
the preparation, structure, and transport properties of single crystals of the ternary compound Bi2O2S.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Bi2O2S is a degenerate n-type semiconductor with a narrow bandgap of about 0.4–0.5 eV.
the Bi2O2Te1−xSe x (0 ≤ x ≤ 1) system is a good candidate for use as a thermoelectric material.
Bi2O2 Se single crystals are n-type semiconductors, and the electron transport is mainly governed by acoustic phonon scattering.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the single crystals are n-type and that the electron effective mass is smaller than the free electron mass.
Bi2O2Te single crystals have potential applications in thermoelectric devices.
the obtained experimental data can be well described by a simple model of the single-valley conduction.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Bi2O2Te single crystals can be grown in a simple and reproducible manner, and the transport properties can be described by the single-valley model.
the Bi2O2Te0.5Se0.5 single crystals can be used as a thermoelectric material for applications in the temperature range from 80 to 470 K.
the Bi2O2Te and Bi2O2(Se, Te) single crystals can serve as promising materials for thermoelectric applications.
